text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim in opening and closing","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and returns to it in the conclusion, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with separate points","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in a more structured way, with distinct paragraphs for cost, driver carelessness, and machine fault."},{"evidence":"\"First, lets talk about the monetary situation\"","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It offers multiple supporting reasons rather than mainly restating an opinion."},{"evidence":"quotation about Google cars not truly driverless","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"It uses details from the article to back up its claims instead of relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"\"Wouldn't this mean...\" and \"That is a good question\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges possible benefits and objections, then explains why its own position still stands."},{"evidence":"ending about costs, safety, and one faulty car","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It closes by summarizing and extending the argument in a fuller way than the other essay."}]}
